SELECT e.id AS id, e.id AS enrollmentId, u.name AS studentName, u.login_id AS studentLoginId, e.midterm_score AS midtermScore, e.final_score AS finalScore, e.assignment_score AS assignmentScore, e.attendance_score AS attendanceScore, e.grade_status AS status, e.objection_reply AS objectionReply, e.letter_grade AS grade FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE e.lecture_id = #{lectureId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name ASC
mapper.update:
UPDATE enrollments e JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id SET e.midterm_score = #{dto.midtermScore}, e.final_score = #{dto.finalScore}, e.assignment_score = #{dto.assignmentScore}, e.attendance_score = #{dto.attendanceScore}, e.total_score = (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0), e.letter_grade = CASE WHEN #{dto.grade} IS NOT NULL AND #{dto.grade} != '' THEN #{dto.grade}
WHEN ( (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0) ) >= 95 THEN 'A+'
WHEN ( (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0) ) >= 90 THEN 'A'
WHEN ( (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0) ) >= 85 THEN 'B+'
WHEN ( (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0) ) >= 80 THEN 'B'
WHEN ( (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0) ) >= 75 THEN 'C+'
WHEN ( (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0) ) >= 70 THEN 'C'
WHEN ( (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0) ) >= 65 THEN 'D+'
WHEN ( (IFNULL(#{dto.midtermScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.midterm_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.finalScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.final_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.assignmentScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.assignment_ratio, 30) / 100.0) + (IFNULL(#{dto.attendanceScore}, 0) * IFNULL(l.attendance_ratio, 10) / 100.0) ) >= 60 THEN 'D'
ELSE 'F' END WHERE e.id = #{dto.enrollmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT lectures.id AS lectureId, courses.code AS courseCode, departments.name AS departmentName, courses.name AS courseName, courses.credits AS credit, courses.target_grade AS targetGrade, users.name AS professorName, lectures.classroom AS classroom, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id ) AS schedule, lectures.capacity AS capacity FROM lectures JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN departments ON courses.department_id = departments.id JOIN professors ON lectures.professor_id = professors.id JOIN users ON professors.user_id = users.id WHERE professors.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY courses.name ASC
